title: chamaespartium sagittale subsp. delphinense
intro: Chamaespartium sagittale subsp. delphinense, commonly known as French broom, is a perennial legume native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Chamaespartium sagittale subsp. delphinense include astringent, anti-catarrhal, and expectorant properties, which help in soothing and protecting the mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
